## Walkthrough

Replaces multiple UserWorkloadConfiguration interval helpers with a unified validation implemented in `(*UserWorkloadConfiguration).validate()` and package-level interval bounds parsed in `init()`. Adds `(*Config).validate()` invoked from `NewConfigFromString*`, wrapping failures as `ErrConfigValidation`. Strengthens validation for Prometheus/Thanos query-log paths, PrometheusK8s collection profiles, KSM additional-resource-labels (`kube-state-metrics:`), and Metrics Server audit profile; empty user workload input is treated as `{}`. `NewUserWorkloadConfigFromConfigMap` no longer returns a default when key missing; `NewDefaultUserWorkloadMonitoringConfig` reuses `NewUserConfigFromString("{}")`. In manifests, `setupQueryLogFile` and `setupProfilesToIgnore` were made non-erroring and audit-profile validation removed. Tests updated to assert `ErrConfigValidation` and use `require` assertions.

## Estimated code review effort

🎯 4 (Complex) | ⏱️ ~40 minutes

`423-433`: _⚠️ Potential issue_ | _🟡 Minor_ **Normalize `queryLogFile` before enforcing the root and `/dev` rules.** These checks run on the raw string, so paths like `/tmp/../query.log` or `/dev/../null` bypass the intended restrictions even though they resolve there at runtime. Validate against `filepath.Clean(path)` first.
Suggested fix ```diff func validateQueryLogFile(path string) error { if path == "" { return nil } - dirPath := filepath.Dir(path) - if !filepath.IsAbs(path) && dirPath != "." { + cleanPath := filepath.Clean(path) + dirPath := filepath.Dir(cleanPath) + if !filepath.IsAbs(cleanPath) && dirPath != "." { return errors.New("relative paths to query log file are not supported") } if dirPath == "/" { return errors.New("query log file can't be stored on the root directory") } - if dirPath == "/dev" && path != "/dev/stdout" && path != "/dev/stderr" && path != "/dev/null" { + if dirPath == "/dev" && cleanPath != "/dev/stdout" && cleanPath != "/dev/stderr" && cleanPath != "/dev/null" { return errors.New("query log file can't be stored on a new file on the dev directory") } return nil } ```
🧹 Nitpick comments (2)
pkg/manifests/manifests_test.go (1)
`1826-1843`: **Add a user-workload query-log coverage case.** This table now only exercises `NewConfigFromString`, but `UserWorkloadConfiguration.validate()` also calls `validateQueryLogFile()`. A small `NewUserConfigFromString` / `PrometheusUserWorkload` variant here would keep the new validation path covered on both loaders.
pkg/manifests/config.go (1)
`390-392`: **Avoid nesting `ErrConfigValidation` in the KSM path.** `validateAdditionalResourceLabels()` already wraps `ErrConfigValidation`, and `NewConfigFromStringAndClusterMonitoringResource()` wraps it again at the top level. Adding another `%w` layer here makes the rendered error repeat `invalid value for config` unnecessarily.
